scripts.build: node scripts/generate-frontend-validators.mjs && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && rm -rf dist/schema && cp -R schema dist/schema && node scripts/verify-schema-registry.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/dashboard... build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/dashboard^... build && node scripts/generate-frontend-validators.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
